Record Class NitriteEntityMeta<T>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.mapping.NitriteEntityMeta<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the entity type
Record Components:
writableProps - the list of writable properties
mappedByAssocs - the list of mapped-by associations
idProp - the identity property (if any)
versionProp - the version property (if any)
persistentEntity - the cached RuntimePersistentEntity (avoids registry lookup)
cascadeProps - pre-filtered list of cascade-capable associations (for PERSIST/ALL)
hasBackReferences - true if this entity has any mappedBy associations with back-ref properties
idAccessor - cached BeanProperty accessor for the ID property
@Internal public record NitriteEntityMeta<T>(List<WritablePropertyMeta<T>> writableProps, List<WritablePropertyMeta<T>> mappedByAssocs, @Nullable io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentProperty<T> idProp, @Nullable io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentProperty<T> versionProp, io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentEntity<T> persistentEntity, List<io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimeAssociation<T>> cascadeProps, boolean hasBackReferences, @Nullable io.micronaut.core.beans.BeanProperty<T,Object> idAccessor) extends Record
Pre-computed metadata for one entity type, cached in entityMetaCache.
Since:
5.2.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
